name: Snap Gourmet Foods, Inc.
old_description: Majority Partners and Founders Jason Chamoun, Allan Lam, and Lincoln Yee founded Snap Gourmet Foods in the heart of the pandemic in 2020 to create an Oasis in the middle of a food desert in Cleveland.
about:
Snap Gourmet Foods, Inc. was founded in 2020 in Cleveland, Ohio, by majority partners Jason Chamoun, Allan Lam, and Lincoln Yee. The trio launched the company during the pandemic with the goal of creating a food oasis in a Cleveland food desert.

The company operates a USDA-inspected facility with more than 40,000 square feet of production space. It manufactures packaged meals, meal kits, sandwiches, wrapped sandwiches, pizzas, and other hand-held foods, offered in shelf-stable, refrigerated, and frozen formats for local and nationwide distribution. Capabilities include sealing food or food components in clear bags, as well as full-service catering and pre-plating foodservice for events ranging from 20 to 1,000 guests.

Snap Gourmet serves private schools, preschools, corporate cafeterias, schools, food banks, and aging agencies. Its meal kits and food boxes are designed to address food insecurity, while its catering division provides chef-inspired cuisine spanning Italian, Latin, Asian, and other styles, accommodating gluten-free, vegan, and other dietary requirements.

The founders, veterans of the food industry who previously founded Symba Brand Solutions and International Food Solutions, state that the company's chief mission is to be a leader in healthy, quality packaged meal solutions, with a focus on quality and a preference for sourcing local ingredients.

name: Solar Alliance
old_description: Solar Alliance is your engineering, procurement and construction source for solar projects on every scale – from large commercial installations to solar for small businesses.  The Solar Alliance team is committed to helping you meet corporate mandates, evaluate and conserve current energy usage, then save money with solar. Solar Alliance is your source for solar power design in the Southeast and beyond. With years of experience in project management and professionals certified by the North American Board of Energy Practitioners (NABCEP), we have the ability to provide solutions for your commercial solar project anywhere in North America.
about:
Based in Knoxville, Tennessee, Solar Alliance operates as an engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) firm specializing in commercial and community-scale solar energy projects. The company serves clients across the Southeast and nationally, with a noted presence in Tennessee and Kentucky.

Solar Alliance provides end-to-end solar project delivery, including design, engineering, procurement of equipment, construction, and utility interconnection coordination. Its staff includes professionals certified by the North American Board of Energy Practitioners (NABCEP). The company handles projects ranging from rooftop installations for small businesses to multi-megawatt community solar arrays and solar-plus-storage systems for data centers and manufacturing facilities.

The firm works across manufacturing, data center, professional building, agricultural, and utility sectors. Past clients include AAMCO in Lebanon, Tennessee; Faith Lutheran Church in Oak Ridge, Tennessee; and TENTE Casters, Inc. in Hebron, Kentucky. Solar Alliance also develops community solar projects for utilities and offers a Solar 101 continuing education course for industry professionals.

The company emphasizes on-time, on-budget execution and long-term utility relationships to streamline interconnection. It positions its expertise in project management and troubleshooting as a differentiator against newer market entrants, focusing on solutions that align with corporate sustainability mandates and energy cost reduction goals.

name: Solar Alternatives, Inc.
old_description: Since 2008, Solar Alternatives has proudly helped thousands of commercial and residential property owners across Louisiana install modern solar panel systems that strengthen a property’s energy efficiency and overall value.
about:
Solar Alternatives, Inc. was founded in 2008 in New Orleans, Louisiana. The company serves commercial and residential property owners across the state, focusing on solar energy systems and related services.

The firm designs and installs solar photovoltaic systems, battery storage, and electric-vehicle charging equipment for homes and businesses. It also provides repair, maintenance, and cleaning services for existing solar arrays, including 24‑hour emergency response. Its team includes expert engineers and certified installers who develop custom system designs tailored to each property’s energy profile. The company reports having served thousands of customers throughout Louisiana.

Solar Alternatives works primarily with residential homeowners in the New Orleans area and commercial property owners across Louisiana. Its residential projects address high electricity costs, frequent grid outages, and hurricane‑related power loss, while its commercial installations help businesses reduce operating expenses and meet sustainability goals.

The company emphasizes a full‑service model that spans initial design through ongoing maintenance, backed by comprehensive warranties. It highlights its local expertise — engineers and installers familiar with New Orleans’ climate and building codes — as a key differentiator, along with the use of certified, durable solar products and responsive service support.

name: Solar Heat & Electric
old_description: All across the great plains, there is a sunny change in attitude towards solar energy. Quantum improvements in technology are driving down cost. Citizens clamor to minimize the burning of fossil fuels. State governments issue sizable tax credit (30%) to accelerate savings even more.
about:
Solar Heat & Electric was founded in 1983 in Omaha, Nebraska, beginning with solar thermal and energy conservation under the leadership of solar visionary Michael Shonka.

The firm designs and installs grid-tied solar photovoltaic systems ranging from residential rooftops to utility-scale arrays, including 25 kW and 50 kW installations. Its capabilities span solar thermal, energy conservation consulting, net-metering interconnection, community solar development, and specialized applications such as center-pivot irrigation and aquaponics systems. The company also developed a solar training curriculum for Nebraska community colleges.

Solar Heat & Electric serves residential, agricultural, commercial, and municipal customers. Notable installations include the Winnebago Police/Fire Station in collaboration with the Ponca Tribe, Bellevue and Lincoln police stations, the Army Corps of Engineers’ 50 kW water-pumping system, Metropolitan Community College’s solar lab, Creighton University’s Kiewit Fitness Center array, Lincoln Electric Systems’ 200-module service center roof, and Central City’s first community solar project.

The company emphasizes its three-decade track record and NABCEP-certified installation expertise as risk reducers for clients. Michael Shonka’s university teaching and association leadership further underscore the depth of technical knowledge applied to every project.

name: Solar On Earth
old_description: A community solar program through Solar On Earth allows anyone (residential or commercial and regardless if you rent or own) to opt into a local community solar energy farm. The local solar farm allows you to take advantage of solar power without rooftop panels. You will help reduce emissions and lower your utility bill through solar credits.
about:
Solar On Earth is headquartered in Chelmsford, Massachusetts, with a secondary office in Chadwick, Illinois. The company operates a community solar program that enables residential and commercial customers to subscribe to local solar farms without installing rooftop panels. Founding year and ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The firm administers community solar subscriptions across thirteen states, including Massachusetts, New York, Maryland, Maine, Hawaii, Illinois, Minnesota, Colorado, Vermont, Delaware, New Jersey, Rhode Island, and New Hampshire. It manages the enrollment process, provides ongoing subscriber support, and coordinates utility bill credits generated by the solar farms. The company does not disclose headcount, facility size, or transaction volumes.

Solar On Earth serves both residential and commercial customers regardless of whether they rent or own their property. Its programs are designed to help participants reduce emissions and lower utility bills through solar credits. The company highlights its work in states with aggressive renewable energy targets, such as Massachusetts’ goal of 100 percent renewable electricity by 2035 and New York’s mandate for 70 percent green energy by 2030.

The company emphasizes a hands-on approach, guiding new subscribers through every step of the process and offering ongoing support to ensure continued cost savings. It cites an A+ rating from the Better Business Bureau as a mark of service quality. The program was created to make solar power accessible without the need for rooftop installations.

name: Solar Panel Company
old_description: Switch to clean, renewable solar energy and stop overpaying for electricity. Solar Panel Company in Boston designs and installs custom solar and roofing systems for homeowners across Greater Boston – backed by certified local experts and a 25-year performance guarantee.
about:
Solar Panel Company operates from Boston, Massachusetts, serving homeowners across Greater Boston and surrounding Massachusetts communities. The company has spent years helping residents transition to renewable energy, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. It is structured as a locally based service provider with an in-house team of certified solar and roofing professionals.

The company designs and installs custom rooftop solar arrays, solar heat pumps, home battery systems, EV charging stations, insulation and air sealing, and solar shading. It also provides full roofing services, including new roof installation, repair, and maintenance. All work is performed by the company's own certified crews without subcontractors, and the firm manages permitting, utility coordination, and system monitoring from consultation through activation.

Solar Panel Company serves residential customers exclusively, targeting homeowners in the Greater Boston area who want to reduce electricity costs, add backup power, or improve home energy efficiency. Its service area covers Boston and the broader New England region, with projects tailored to local climate conditions and roof types.

The company differentiates itself by bundling solar and roofing under one roof, offering a 25-year performance guarantee on installations, and assigning a dedicated point of contact for each project. It emphasizes transparent pricing, no hidden fees, and assistance with federal and state incentives such as the Solar Investment Tax Credit and the Massachusetts SMART program.

Solar Panel Store serves residential, recreational vehicle, marine, and off-grid customers. Its product collections cater to off-grid solar, grid-tied solar, RV solar, and boat solar systems. Customers include individual homeowners, RV owners, and marine enthusiasts seeking complete solar solutions.

The company emphasizes comprehensive product selection, competitive pricing, and direct customer support. Its UL-listed product compliance and Colorado-based operations are highlighted as differentiators.
